objective: Establish the first reliable specialist-routing baby step by leaking the stable live expert identities while preserving varied harness-shaped objectives and direct outcome learning.

causal_basis.finding: The 2B router received correct direct rewards but failed to bind capability profiles through arbitrary identity permutations in six updates, then selected source_inspector on every heldout decision.

curriculum.leak_stage: Each live identity retains its real capability: generic_worker for plain files, table_analyst for table reconciliation, and source_inspector for source/config inspection.
retained_difficulty: four varied concrete objective templates per capability
balanced generic, table, and source groups every update
no answer values or hidden task class
curriculum.later_tightening: Introduce registry identity permutations only after the fixed live-registry screen passes.

decision_rule.if_screen_passes: Retain c1j as the first isolated live-registry router candidate and implement the compact split scaffold before end-to-end evaluation.
decision_rule.if_screen_fails: Reject c1j without replacing e33 and stop this router lineage for architectural diagnosis rather than adding updates.
decision_rule.promotion_requires: A later live end-to-end population evaluation with at least four complete qualifying trajectories.
